title: Facebook Page Posts & Comments Scraper input
description: Free page URL → recent posts + comments scraper. No login. Also profiles, groups, and single post URLs. $0 developer fee; only Apify platform usage.

pageOrUrl.title: Page, profile, group, or post URL
pageOrUrl.description: Paste any Facebook link — a page, a profile (including profile.php?id=… and /people/… links), a group, or a single post — or just the handle. Profile tabs (/about, /photos) and tracking parameters are fine. For a Page: scrapes N recent posts then each comment thread. For a post URL: that thread only. Private or login-gated targets will fail. If a target returns 0 posts, change residential proxy country (see README troubleshooting).

maxPosts.title: Max recent posts from page feed
maxPosts.description: How many recent feed posts to scrape (with comments). Ignored when afterDate/beforeDate is set — then the Actor walks the feed until the date window ends. Ignored for a single post URL. Each post's comments are paginated in full, so runtime and proxy cost scale with how many comments the posts have — raise this once you have seen what one post costs on your target.

profile.title: Policy profile
profile.description: default = 3 workers + reply cap 1500 (best quality/time); tops_only = no replies, so coverage drops on pages that reply to their commenters, and it is often slower because it serialises on one worker; full_replies = always fetch replies (not recommended).

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: async = streaming httpx (recommended on Apify); threads = requests thread pool.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify residential proxy (on by default). Main reliability lever. If runs return 0 posts for a public target, set proxy country to match the audience (or your country) and retry — wrong exits often get empty feeds.

afterDate.title: Posts on or after
afterDate.description: Calendar date. Keep posts from this day onward (inclusive), using midnight in dateTimezone. Leave empty for no lower bound. Example: pick 2026-07-31 and set "Posts before" to 2026-08-01 for that local day only.

beforeDate.title: Posts before
beforeDate.description: Calendar date. Keep posts strictly before this day (exclusive), using midnight in dateTimezone. Leave empty for no upper bound. When using a date filter, afterDate is required so pagination knows when to stop.

dateTimezone.title: Date timezone
dateTimezone.description: Timezone for afterDate/beforeDate midnight. Use UTC (default), an offset like +3 or +03:00, or an IANA name (Africa/Khartoum, Asia/Riyadh). Unix afterTime/beforeTime ignore this.

postsOnly.title: Posts only
postsOnly.description: Discover posts (with created_time) and skip comment/reply scraping. nested_replies_on will be false.

workers.title: Workers (advanced)
workers.description: Override the worker count from the profile.

replyFbCap.title: Reply cap (advanced)
replyFbCap.description: Fetch replies only when a post's FB comment_count is below this. 0 = tops only.

maxComments.title: Max comments per post
maxComments.description: Stop paginating top-level comments after this many per post. Heavy threads are truncated instead of skipped. Leave empty for no limit.

minIntervalSec.title: Min interval seconds (advanced)
minIntervalSec.description: Pause between comment pages, per worker. Higher = gentler on rate limits.

megaThreshold.title: Mega threshold (advanced)
megaThreshold.description: If set, pin the single heaviest post to a dedicated worker.
